changelog:
- Integrates Help Scout through the OOMOL `oo` CLI using server-side credentials.
- Supports reading Help Scout conversations, customers, inboxes, folders, tags, users, workflows, saved replies, and threads.
- Enables conversation management actions such as assignment, status changes, snoozing, tags, custom fields, replies, and internal notes.
- Provides create actions for new conversations and customers.
- Includes safety guidance for confirming write operations and handling first-time setup/authentication issues.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@3e4b3ff`
summary: Help Scout (helpscout.com). Use this skill for ANY Help Scout request — reading, creating, and updating data. Whenever a task involves Help Scout, use this skill instead of calling the API directly.
